acceptance.assertion: A dated official or primary-near source is checked by 2026-08-24 and recorded with URL, retrieval date, source role and the exact operating-status claim it supports.

The catalog record uses activity.status=active only when the timely source explicitly supports current operation; otherwise activity.status remains unknown with the required public disclosure and a refreshed next-review date.
No turbine, intake, cable, household, route, plot or other private infrastructure location is reconstructed; any geographic presentation remains a separately justified coarse public reference.

Canonical data, English presentation overlay, generated public shells, taxonomy projections and delivery evidence remain synchronized, and the full validation plus public browser smoke pass on the exact head.

Closeout binds the complete diff and exact head to green required CI, review evidence, merge commit and public production readback without claiming operating continuity beyond the checked source date.

approval.note: Any status change must be bound to timely source evidence. Do not infer active operation from the 2019 project description, and do not add exact private infrastructure geometry.

goal: Reverify the current operating status of Kobulu Community Micro Hydro using timely official or primary-near evidence, update Commonworld only when that evidence supports the change, and otherwise preserve the explicit unknown-status disclosure without implying operation or exact private infrastructure locations.

does_not_establish: permission to infer operation from a 2019 project page
an exact site or infrastructure location
automatic queue, claim, dispatch, merge or deployment authority

title: Reverify Kobulu Community Micro Hydro operating status
